classification: Production-readiness gap requiring a guaranteed reset strategy or demonstrated compliant supply ramp

facts.sensor_requirement: Honeywell MPR datasheet issueK §4.0 p11 requires at least10V/ms VDD rising slope; otherwise use RES after supply stabilized.
facts.regulator: TI TPS563203 revA §6.3.3 specifies typical1.4ms internal soft-start.
facts.reset_pullup: R22=10k fromRES to3V3; TP3probeaccess; no active resetcontroller attached.

inference: Nominal buck soft-start is substantially slower than sensor power-on slope requirement. The present pull-up alone does not create an active low-to-high reset after3V3 stabilizes; sensor startup is therefore not guaranteed by design. Average ramp estimate is not an oscilloscope measurement of the actual waveform.
possible_symptom: Sensor may fail or behave inconsistently after cold start or brownout; no claim that every board will fail.
action: Before production approval, provide a guaranteed post-stable reset (e.g. suitable voltage supervisor, or properly sequenced host-controlled connection viaTP3) or obtain measured/manufacturer-accepted proof of compliance. Scope3V3 atU5 andRES during cold/hot starts and brownouts. No design modification performed.
